apps.name: Passkey Vault
apps.description: Stores passkeys on your phone and signs you in to apps, browsers and desktop sites.

apps.name: Mindscroll
apps.description: Counts the reels and shorts you swipe through each day in Instagram, YouTube and Facebook, and keeps the number in your status bar, around the camera and on a widget.

apps.name: Glimpse
apps.description: A widget-first app for two people to share real-time messages, photos and reactions from the home screen.

apps.name: Jianghu Chain
apps.description: Wuxia story game. Play a chain of heroes: each one's choices, grudges and techniques pass to the next.

apps.name: Androvia
apps.description: Secure device runtime that runs only the capabilities you enable on this phone. Early foundation build: no relay connection yet.

apps.name: Documents
apps.description: Reads PDF files. Opens them from your files or from other apps. Word and editing support are planned.

apps.name: Apkforge
apps.description: Inspects Android APKs on your phone: package details, file list, export. Works offline.

apps.name: Contacts
apps.description: Contacts, dialer, call history, incoming calls and call recording. Replaces your phone app when set as default, so try it on a spare phone first.

prereleaseApps.name: Passkey Demo
prereleaseApps.description: Test app for trying passkeys the way other apps use them. Not Passkey Vault.

prereleaseApps.name: Crypto Lab
prereleaseApps.description: Experiment app for sending messages and files to another phone over an encrypted channel (Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, paired by QR code).

prereleaseApps.name: Island Lab
prereleaseApps.description: Test app for the phone's own island and Live Update chip: posts sample notifications and logs what the phone allows. Not Mindscroll.
